assigned.title: The video child HWND is resized to zero the instant after it is created
assigned.acceptance:
FOUND BY PL-0748's INSTRUMENTATION ON ITS FIRST RUN, which is what that task was for. The diagnostic log is decisive and rules out every hypothesis except geometry: the file opened, HEVC was detected, mpv initialised, D3D11 came up on an RTX 3050, d3d11va hardware decoding was active, the VO reported 'gpu-next 1920x1080 d3d11[nv12]', the first video frame rendered and playback completed. Nothing about media, codec, mpv or decision D1 failed. mpv also reported 'Window size: 1x1' and 'Video display: ... -> (0,0) 1x1'.

THE DEFECT, which has been present since PL-0742 wrote the harness. `create_child` creates the child at the parent's client size with CreateWindowExW, and then calls SetWindowPos(child, HWND_BOTTOM, 0, 0, 0, 0, SWP_NOACTIVATE | SWP_SHOWWINDOW). SWP_NOSIZE is absent, so cx=0 and cy=0 are honoured and the window is resized to nothing one line after being created correctly. mpv surfaces a zero-area window as 1x1. `fit_child` passes real dimensions and is NOT affected -- it simply never ran, because it is wired to Resized and ScaleFactorChanged and the commander never resized the window.

REQUIRED: the initial SetWindowPos stops zeroing the window -- either by carrying SWP_NOSIZE or by passing the real client width and height. Passing the dimensions is preferred: it leaves no 0, 0, 0, 0 in the source for the next reader to wonder about.

REQUIRED: fit_child runs ONCE immediately after mpv is initialised, rather than waiting for a resize or DPI event that may never come. The first run is the proof that waiting is not safe.

REQUIRED: the client rectangle is recorded in the existing diagnostic log at both points. This is two lines through machinery PL-0748 already built, not new infrastructure, and it covers the one case the fix alone does not: if GetClientRect legitimately returns zero because the window is not realised at Tauri setup() time, the corrected run must say so instead of looking like the same failure again.

REQUIRED: NOTHING ELSE CHANGES. Same architecture, same child HWND, same HWND_BOTTOM z-order, same WS_CLIPSIBLINGS, same transparency, same mpv property set, same diagnostic logging. The experiment is about that exact arrangement and a fix round that altered it would answer a different question.

MUST NOT: mark Experiment 1a PASS, mark PW-0103 PASS, change decision D1, or add further diagnostic infrastructure. A corrected binary that renders video is still only criterion 1 and 2 observed on one machine by one person; the seven criteria and the matrix are unchanged and unmet.
assigned.notes: FILED 2026-10-06. PL-0748 is BLOCKED rather than DONE because it holds this file and cannot reach DONE without gpt-architect's verdict; its block reason records that in full, including that its engineering is complete and proven by this very finding. This is the defect its instrumentation was built to expose, exposed on the first run.

build.evidence:
cargo clippy --locked --all-targets -D warnings: clean for BOTH x86_64-pc-windows-msvc and the host. repo:validate passed. Cargo.lock unchanged -- no dependency moved.

THE FIXED CALL SITE IS REALLY COMPILED FOR WINDOWS, proved rather than assumed: replacing `height` with a string literal in the corrected SetWindowPos produced 2 errors for the Windows target, and was then reverted. The whole fix lives behind #[cfg(windows)] and would otherwise be invisible to a check run in this container.

WHAT CHANGED, and it is three things:
  1. create_child's SetWindowPos passes the real client width and height instead of 0, 0 without SWP_NOSIZE. That is the defect: a child created at the client size and resized to nothing one statement later, which mpv surfaces as "Window size: 1x1".
  2. fit_child runs ONCE immediately after mpv initialises. It was wired only to Resized and ScaleFactorChanged, so on a run where nobody resized the window the creation geometry was the geometry for the whole session, and nothing ever corrected it.
  3. The parent client rect is recorded at both points through PL-0748's existing Diag, with an explicit warning if it is zero. Two lines, no new infrastructure, and they cover the one case the fix alone cannot: a window not yet realised at Tauri setup() time answers GetClientRect with zero and produces an identical symptom.

WHAT DID NOT CHANGE, deliberately: the child HWND, HWND_BOTTOM, WS_CLIPSIBLINGS, transparency, the mpv property set and the diagnostic logging. The experiment is about that exact arrangement.

NOT CLAIMED: that this makes video appear. Nothing here has run. Experiment 1a is not PASS, PW-0103 is untouched and D1 is unchanged. Even a corrected run that shows video is criterion 1 and 2 on one machine -- the seven criteria and the OS/GPU/DPI matrix are unmet.
